questions.question: Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions. The Suez Canal, an artificial sea-level waterway in Egypt, connects the Mediterranean Sea to the Red Sea through the Isthmus of Suez. Officially opened in November 1869, it offers watercraft a more direct route between the North Atlantic and northern Indian oceans via the Mediterranean and Red seas, avoiding the South Atlantic and southern Indian oceans. This effectively reduces the journey distance from the Arabian Sea to London by approximately 8,900 kilometres. The canal extends 193 km from Port Said on the Mediterranean Sea to Suez on the Red Sea. In recent years, the canal's strategic importance was underscored by the "New Suez Canal" project, an $8.5 billion expansion completed in 2015. This initiative involved deepening the existing channel and creating a new 35-kilometer lane to allow for two-way traffic in parts of the canal. Despite modern engineering, the waterway remains vulnerable to physical blockages and geopolitical tensions. As a vital artery for global trade, particularly for oil and consumer goods, any disruption to its flow can trigger significant inflationary pressures across international markets and supply chains. Q- What is the primary geographical benefit of the Suez Canal mentioned in the text?

questions.question: If 27x³ − 64y³ = (Ax + By)(Cx² + Dy² − Exy), then value of (A−B+C−D+E) will be:
questions.questionHtml: If 27x³ − 64y³ = (Ax + By)(Cx² + Dy² − Exy), then value of (A−B+C−D+E) will be:
questions.solution:
Given,
27x³ − 64y³ = (Ax + By)(Cx² + Dy² − Exy)

(3x − 4y)(9x² + 16y² + 12xy) = (Ax + By)(Cx² + Dy² − Exy)

On comparing both sides, we get,

A = 3, B = −4, C = 9, D = 16, E = −12

Hence,

A − B + C − D + E
= 3 + 4 + 9 − 16 + (−12)
= 16 − 16 − 12
= −12

TSA = 6a²

6a² = 150
a² = 25
a = 5 cm

Volume = a³ = 5³ = 125 cm³

questions.question: A is 40% more efficient than B and C is 20% less efficient than B. Working together, they can complete a task in 20 hours. In how many hours will A alone complete 28% of that task?
questions.questionHtml: A is 40% more efficient than B and C is 20% less efficient than B. Working together, they can complete a task in 20 hours. In how many hours will A alone complete 28% of that task?
questions.solution:
Let B = 10

A = 14 (40% more)
C = 8 (20% less)

Total efficiency = 14 + 10 + 8 = 32

Total work = 32 × 20 = 640

28% work = 0.28 × 640 = 179.2

Time by A = 179.2 / 14 = 12.8 hours

Answer: 12.8 hours

questions.question: A vessel is full of 90 litre milk, 18 litre milk is taken out and replaced by water and again this process is repeated 2 times, the amount of milk left after the 3rd replacement is
questions.questionHtml: A vessel is full of 90 litre milk, 18 litre milk is taken out and replaced by water and again this process is repeated 2 times, the amount of milk left after the 3rd replacement is
questions.solution:
Total milk = 90 L

Fraction remaining each time = 1 − 18/90 = 4/5

After 3 operations

Milk left = 90 × (4/5)³

= 90 × 64/125

= 46.08 L
